examples.en: You won't believe this, but the train conductor remembered us from Tuesday.
examples.zh: 你绝对想不到，列车员居然还记得我们是周二坐过他车的人。

situation.en: You won't believe this: the tiny bar had a queue of locals at midnight.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 你绝对想不到（讲故事的起手式）

examples.en: Long story short, we slept in the airport and it was weirdly fun.
examples.zh: 长话短说，我们睡了机场，居然还挺好玩。

situation.en: Long story short: wrong bus, right village, best meal of the trip.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: It turned out that the 'closed' museum opens free on Sundays.
examples.zh: 结果发现，那家“关门”的博物馆周日免费开放。

situation.en: It turned out that our taxi driver was a retired history teacher.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: Out of nowhere, the whole village square started dancing.
examples.zh: 毫无征兆地，整个村子广场开始跳舞。

situation.en: The storm arrived out of nowhere at four and left by five.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 毫无征兆地、突然冒出来

examples.en: Before we knew it, we had spent three hours in a bookshop.
examples.zh: 不知不觉，我们在书店里待了三个小时。

situation.en: Before we knew it, the last train was a rumor.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: The sunrise ferry was the highlight of the trip, easily.
examples.zh: 日出那班渡轮是整趟旅行的高光时刻，没悬念。

situation.en: Cooking with our host family — highlight of the trip, no contest.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: Seeing the volcano glow at night is a once in a lifetime thing.
examples.zh: 夜里看到火山口发光，是一生一次的事。

situation.en: Expensive, yes — but a once in a lifetime seat at that table.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: The funny thing is, we found it by getting completely lost.
examples.zh: 有意思的是，我们是彻底迷路才找到它的。

situation.en: The funny thing is, the backup plan beat the plan.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: Plot twist: the grumpy ticket inspector sang in a choir with our guide.
examples.zh: 剧情反转：那个凶巴巴的检票员和我们的导游是同一个合唱团的。

situation.en: Plot twist — the 'tourist trap' was run by the chef's grandmother.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: Fast forward to midnight: we're eating noodles with the night guards.
examples.zh: 快进到午夜：我们正和夜班保安一起吃面。

situation.en: Fast forward to the airport — and the bag still hadn't appeared.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 快进到（跳过中间讲后面）

examples.en: Looking back, the rained-out day gave us the best stories.
examples.zh: 现在回头看，被雨泡汤的那天给了我们最好的故事。

situation.en: Looking back, getting lost was the itinerary we actually needed.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: Little did I know, the old man at breakfast owned the whole vineyard.
examples.zh: 我当时完全没想到，早餐桌上那位老人拥有整个葡萄园。

situation.en: Little did I know, that wrong turn was the trip introducing itself.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 我当时完全没想到（悬念式回望）

examples.en: Small world: my university roommate, in a café in Lisbon.
examples.zh: 世界真小：我的大学室友，在里斯本一家咖啡馆里。

situation.en: Small world — the diver next to me grew up two streets from my parents.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 世界真小（异地遇熟人的感叹）

examples.en: Our host was a kindred spirit: same books, same jokes, different continent.
examples.zh: 我们的房东是一见如故的人：同样的书、同样的笑话，只是不同大洲。

situation.en: You find a kindred spirit fast when the ferry is cancelled together.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 灵魂相通的人、一见如故的人

examples.en: We meant to plan tomorrow; instead we talked until midnight about everything else.
examples.zh: 我们本来想计划明天，结果聊到半夜的全是别的。

situation.en: Good hosts make you talk until midnight without noticing.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: On night trains, strangers swap stories like currency.
examples.zh: 在夜班火车上，陌生人像交换货币一样交换故事。

situation.en: We swapped stories with the fishermen until their shift started.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: A home-cooked meal beats the famous restaurant, every single trip.
examples.zh: 一顿家常饭胜过那家名餐厅，每次旅行都如此。

situation.en: She apologized for 'just a home-cooked meal' — it was the best food in the country.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: A second helping is the loudest compliment a cook can hear.
examples.zh: 再来一份是厨师能听到的最响亮的夸奖。

situation.en: Take a second helping slowly; thirds are negotiations.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: The guesthouse made us feel at home by the second morning.
examples.zh: 到第二天早上，这家民宿已经让我们有宾至如归的感觉。

situation.en: A dog, a kettle, and no checkout pressure: you feel at home fast.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: 'Make yourself at home,' she said, pointing at the fridge like family.
examples.zh: “别客气，就像在自己家一样，”她指着冰箱说，像家人一样。

situation.en: When a host says make yourself at home, shoes and tea are the first exam.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 别客气、就像在自己家一样

examples.en: After five loud days, a cozy night in with soup and a film won.
examples.zh: 在吵了五天之后，一个喝着汤看电影的宅家夜晚胜出了。

situation.en: Rain plus a cozy night in beats any viewpoint.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: Every scar and missed train becomes a travel tale by winter.
examples.zh: 每一个伤疤和每一班误掉的火车，到了冬天都会变成旅行故事。

situation.en: Collect travel tales, not fridge magnets.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: The best part was the part we never planned.
examples.zh: 最棒的部分是我们从未计划过的那部分。

situation.en: The best part was breakfast on the roof, daily and unhurried.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: The worst part was the bus station at 4 a.m., and even that became funny.
examples.zh: 最糟的部分是凌晨四点的汽车站，而就连那个后来也变好笑了。

situation.en: The worst part was one night only; the best parts keep renting rooms in my head.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: If you ever go, skip the main square and eat where the buses stop.
examples.zh: 你以后要是去，别去主广场，在公交车停的地方吃。

situation.en: If you ever go in October, book the ferry before the hotels.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 你以后要是去（给建议的开头）

examples.en: That reminds me of the night the ferry simply didn't come.
examples.zh: 这让我想起渡轮干脆没来的那个晚上。

situation.en: That reminds me — I still owe our guide a photo from that day.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: Speaking of which, the driver never did charge us for that detour.
examples.zh: 顺便一提，那个司机最后根本没收我们绕路的钱。

situation.en: Speaking of which, the museum shop sells the map you actually need.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

examples.en: We clicked instantly with the couple from the next tent.
examples.zh: 我们和隔壁帐篷的那对夫妇一见如故。

situation.en: We clicked instantly over a shared hatred of early ferries.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 我们一见如故、一下子就聊开了

examples.en: We shared a table with two students and left with four new friends.
examples.zh: 我们和两个学生拼桌，离开时多了四个新朋友。

situation.en: In crowded beer gardens you shared a table or you don't eat.
situation.zh: 你向朋友讲述旅行见闻，用这个说法开头或转折：

entries.zh: 拼桌（和陌生人同桌吃饭）
